system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.13.2 - Elemental Combat Enhancements. Buffing an elemental ally in combat: Battle Awareness, an invisible Shield, sharper Reactions/initiative, Blur, escalating Aggression/Quickness/Speed/Haste, Peripheral Vision, doubled-damage Strength/Intensify/Empower, Mass and Long Enhancement to extend the next buff's targets or duration, and True Enhancement stacking six of the list's own effects at once. Special note from the source: these spells only work on a being that has a number of corruption points, in the caster's element, equal to twice the level of the spell being cast - otherwise the spell fails outright.
Target gains +25 to his Battle Awareness checks.

Caster creates an invisible force shield in front of the target. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.) Except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.
Targets gain better insight into the future. Targets gain +3 to their initiative rolls.
Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.
Target's level of aggression is increased beyond normal. Attacks that are made while under the effects of this spell are at +10.

Target may act at twice their normal rate (i.e., 200% activity per round), but immediately afterwards must spend a number of rounds equal to the rounds speeded at half rate (i.e., only 50%) per round. See Of Essence for more details.
Target is faster and more fluid for the duration. The target's Defensive Bonus increases by 10 for all attacks of which that target is aware.
Target's peripheral vision is enhanced. Foes attacking target do not get any bonuses for flanking and only a +5 for attacking from the rear.
Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e. 200% activity). See Of Essence for more details.

Target's strength increases for the duration, allowing target to deliver double damage with his melee attacks. This spell does not work on creatures that have their entire make-up from one of the elements (i.e., elementals).
As Speed I, except duration is 4 rounds split among 1 to 4 targets (in any combination.)
As Aggression I, except bonus is +20.

Target Elemental's energy is intensified. All attacks deal double damage, including breath weapons but not spells. If this spell is cast on a non-elemental, then only breath weapons would be affected. For example, if this was cast on a Zephyr Hound, its breath weapon would do double damage but its melee attacks would remain unaffected.
As Haste I, except the duration is 3 rounds, split among 1 to 3 targets (in any combination.)
As Quickness I, except the bonus is +20.
Allows the next spell cast from this list, that is 7th level or lower, to affect one target per level of the caster.
As Haste I, except duration is 5 rounds, split among 1 to 5 targets (in any combination.)
As Aggression I, except the bonus is +30.
All of the target's attacks deal double-damage, even breath weapons. Spells remain unaffected.
As Quickness II, except the bonus is +30.
Allows the next spell cast from this list to last ten minutes per level of the caster.
As Mass Enhancement I, except it will work with any spell on this list 20th level or lower.
Target is under the effects of Battle Awareness, Reactions I, Peripheral Vision, Aggression III, Quickness III, and Empower for the duration.
